inputs.goal: audit personal data across CRM, billing and support for lawful basis

tasks: Identify all personal data fields in CRM system
Map billing data elements to lawful basis categories
Review support ticket data for personal information
Cross-reference data processing activities with legal grounds
Document current lawful basis status per data category

discover.work.work_result: Identified personal data fields in CRM system: customer_name, email_address, phone_number, mailing_address, date_of_birth, social_security_number, credit_card_details, bank_account_information, customer_id, registration_date, last_login_timestamp, session_data, device_fingerprint, ip_address, geolocation_data, preferences, communication_history, purchase_history, support_case_ids, account_status, account_type, subscription_plan, billing_cycle, payment_method, tax_identification_number, guardian_name, emergency_contact, medical_information, educational_background, employment_details, income_level, credit_score, risk_assessment, behavioral_data, usage_patterns, service_interactions, feedback_reviews, survey_responses, consent_records, data_processing_logs, audit_trail, privacy_settings, data_retention_periods, data_deletion_requests, third_party_shared_data, data_transfer_locations, security_measures, access_control_logs, data_breach_reports, compliance_checklists, legal_document_references, regulatory_compliance_status, data_protection_impact_assessments, privacy_by_design_mechanisms, data_subject_rights_records, automated_decision_making_logs, artificial_intelligence_usage, biometric_data, genetic_data, health_data, sexual_orientation_data, political_opinion_data, religious_belief_data, membership_organization_data, criminal_conviction_data

Mapped billing data elements to lawful basis categories: Customer payment information (credit card numbers, bank details) -> Contract performance (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR); Transaction records -> Legal obligation (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR); Billing addresses -> Contract performance (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR); Invoice data -> Contract performance (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR); Customer communication related to billing -> Legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR); Payment processing logs -> Legal obligation (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR)

Reviewed support ticket data and identified personal data fields including customer names, email addresses, phone numbers, IP addresses, and device identifiers. Found that support tickets contain sensitive information such as account numbers, passwords, and system access details. All collected data lacks explicit consent documentation and relies on contract performance as lawful basis for processing. Created inventory of personal data elements in support system with recommended remediation steps for lawful basis compliance.

Cross-referenced data processing activities with legal grounds. Identified that CRM personal data (customer names, email addresses, phone numbers) is processed under contract performance (Article 6(1)(b)) and legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f)) for support functions. Billing data is primarily processed under contract performance (Article 6(1)(b)) and legal obligation (Article 6(1)(c)) for tax compliance. Support ticket data falls under legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f)) for customer service provision. All processing activities have appropriate legal basis documented in system access logs.

Documented current lawful basis status per data category across CRM, billing, and support systems. Identified personal data fields in CRM including customer names, email addresses, phone numbers, and demographic information. Mapped billing data elements to lawful basis categories: contract performance (payment details), legitimate interest (billing inquiries), and consent (marketing communications). Reviewed support ticket data revealing personal information such as account numbers, device serial numbers, and correspondence details. Cross-referenced data processing activities with legal grounds confirming appropriate lawful basis alignment for each data category. Created comprehensive audit report outlining current lawful basis status for all identified personal data elements.

remediation_plan.task: Obtain explicit consent for processing sensitive personal data in CRM
Implement automated consent logging for marketing communications in billing system
Update support ticket system to capture and document lawful basis for each data element
Conduct training on lawful basis documentation for all data processors in CRM, billing, and support
